usageNotes: Use this to provision a new Proxmox VE user account in the specified realm (e.g. `pve`, `pam`, or an LDAP/AD realm). The `userid` must follow the `name@realm` format and the realm must already exist. The `password` field is only meaningful for the built-in `pve` realm — users in external realms (LDAP, AD, OpenID) authenticate against that backend, not Proxmox. The caller needs `Realm.AllocateUser` on the target realm and `User.Modify` on any groups being assigned.

examples.summary: Create a local PVE user assigned to the 'helpdesk' group with a 1-year expiry

tips: The `password` field sets the initial Proxmox-local password and only takes effect for `@pve` realm users; omit it for LDAP/AD/OpenID realm users.
Use `expire` as a Unix epoch integer (e.g. from `date -d '2027-01-01' +%s`); set to 0 for no expiry.
Assigning a user to non-existent groups will cause the request to fail — create groups first via POST /access/groups.
The `keys` field stores YubiKey token IDs for second-factor auth; it does not configure TOTP — that is managed separately.
New users have no ACL permissions by default; grant access via PUT /access/acl after creation.
